protocol.purpose: Feasibility pilot of simple seasonal references, not a novelty or significance claim
protocol.portugal_series_selection: First three records in the published archive, before inspecting errors
protocol.missing_data_policy: Require all source samples in an hourly bin; skip origins with missing values in the previous 336 hours or next 168 hours. No interpolation.
protocol.hybrid_policy: Weekly for target Saturday/Sunday/Monday, daily otherwise. When a daily lookup is after the origin, recursively use the earlier hybrid prediction.
protocol.aggregation_policy: Report per-series errors and relative error; do not average raw MAE across different units or count related meters as independent datasets.
